policy: A model may only be used after its exact provider license has been reviewed and registered here. Shipping (bundling weights in an artifact) and training are separate permissions from local inference. Unknown models, unlisted licenses, and license mismatches fail closed. This registry records review; it is not legal advice.

Llama-3.1-Community.summary: Meta Llama 3.1 Community License Agreement. Commercial use and fine-tuning are permitted. Distribution requires the agreement, a Notice file, and prominent 'Built with Llama' attribution. Models created from Llama materials must be named with a 'Llama' prefix. Entities above 700 million monthly active users need a separate Meta license. Not an OSI-approved license.
obligations: Provide the Llama 3.1 Community License Agreement with distributed materials.
Include the required Llama 3.1 notice file.
Display 'Built with Llama' prominently in related UI, documentation, or release notes.
Do not use Meta trademarks beyond the naming requirements.
Request a separate license above 700 million monthly active users.

Gemma-Terms-of-Use.summary: Google Gemma Terms of Use plus the Gemma Prohibited Use Policy. Commercial use, modification, redistribution, and training derivatives are permitted subject to pass-through use restrictions, agreement and notice delivery, modification marking, and the prohibited-use policy. Not an OSI-approved license. Gemma 2 remains covered by the archived Gemma Terms of Use.
obligations: Pass through the Gemma use restrictions as an enforceable provision.
Provide recipients a copy of the Gemma Terms of Use.
Mark modified files with prominent modification notices.
Include the required Gemma notice text for non-hosted distribution.
Comply with the Gemma Prohibited Use Policy.
Do not claim Google endorsement or use Gemma trademarks.
